Hi Rajeev / Lena —

Attached is a short usage packet for Q2 (orbis_q2_usage_report.pdf). High-level callouts:
- May total token spend: ~2.1B tokens (generation 840M, embeddings 1.26B)
- Monthly spend trend: +38% vs March baseline, driven by expanded embeddings for search+personalization
- Avg gen latency (p95) on hosted model: 95ms; occasional spikes to ~280ms during peak windows

We expect Orbis to cross the commit threshold we discussed next quarter. Monica and I sketched two options: a 15% commit uplift with a 10% term discount, or a Dedicated pilot (3-month) with burst credits for spiky traffic.

Would you be open to a 30-minute sync next week to walk through the packet and pick a path? If helpful, we can share an itemized impact table (tokens by feature + projected unit costs) before the call.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

Hi Rajeev — great to hear numbers align. Per your asks, I attached a short proposal (proposed-term-amendment-v2.pdf) that contains:
- A 12-month amendment with a 15% uplift in committed tokens (annualized) and a 10% unit-price discount for generation/embeddings.
- A 3-month Dedicated pilot option: Reserved pool sized to 30% of peak and an add-on "burst buffer" of 40% for 60% of the pilot period. SLA: 99.5% uptime for p95 latency; credits for SLA violations outlined.
- Line-items: projected monthly costs by feature (search, personalization, recommendations) and break-even date assuming current growth.

Key tradeoffs to call out internally: the Dedicated pilot reduces per-token unit cost by ~18% during pilot windows but requires a 3-month minimum and an ops kickoff. The straight commit is lower friction but gives less headroom for bursty nightly runs.

Suggested agenda for sync (30 min):
1) Walk packet + per-feature cost table (10 min)
2) Pilot mechanics & SLA Q&A (10 min)
3) Procurement timeline & next steps (10 min)

Vivek / Rajeev — if that works, Monica and I can send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-term-amendment-v2.pdf (1 page summary, 240KB)

Internal note (not sent to Orbis):
- If Orbis opts for the 15% commit uplift + 10% discount, expected ARR increase of $360k with a 9-month payback (assuming 25% growth Y/Y).
- Dedicated pilot likely to convert at +32% ARR uplift post-pilot if latency and cost targets are met.
- Approval ask: leadership sign-off for one-time pilot activation credit of $25k to reduce friction on their OPEX evaluation; this credit would be tied to execution of a 3-month pilot and non-refundable after day 45.

Recommend: get procurement quote started and surface the pilot credit to leadership for quick yes — this unlocks near-term expansion.

-Karthik
